caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic jar with a wide, round body that tapers slightly towards the base and features two small, ear-shaped handles on either side near the shoulder. The jar is primarily light tan or beige in color, with a glossy finish. The mouth of the jar is wide and circular, with a slightly raised, rounded rim that has a brownish hue on the interior. On the front surface of the jar, there is a decorative design comprising two stylized blue flowers with curling petals, accompanied by blue leaves and stems positioned between the flowers. Above the floral motif, there is a circular stamp or emblem marked with the words "JACOB CLINE / HARRISBURG PA" in blue text. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color. The artist's signature, "GEO. LOUGHRIDGE," appears in the lower right corner.
title: Jar
